definitions.explanation: The thing that should be dealt with before all others; the most important matter requiring attention.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}を{最優先|さいゆうせん}にする。
examples.english: To make safety the top priority.

examples.japanese: この{案件|あんけん}は{最優先|さいゆうせん}で{対応|たいおう}してください。
examples.english: Please handle this matter with the highest priority.

examples.japanese: {被災者|ひさいしゃ}の{救助|きゅうじょ}が{最優先|さいゆうせん}の{課題|かだい}だと{政府|せいふ}は{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced that rescuing disaster victims is the top priority.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly used in the patterns {最優先|さいゆうせん}にする (to make top priority), {最優先|さいゆうせん}で (with top priority), and {最優先|さいゆうせん}の{課題|かだい} (top-priority issue). Frequent in business and government contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最優先|さいゆうせん}{事項|じこう}: top-priority matter
- {最優先|さいゆうせん}{課題|かだい}: top-priority issue
- {最優先|さいゆうせん}で{対応|たいおう}する: to respond with top priority
- ～を{最優先|さいゆうせん}にする: to make ~ the top priority
